title: 七下 · 经历与计划训练卷
scope: 过去经历、将来计划、情态动词与有依据的简单推断；原创笔试能力训练。
language: We [[1]] the school museum yesterday afternoon.
yesterday afternoon 明确是过去时间，用 visited。
visit 未体现这里已结束的过去动作。
visiting 不能独立作这个句子的谓语。
I didn't [[1]] the note until I got home.
didn't 后接动词原形 read。
didn't 后不改过去式，且 read 的过去式也不是 readed。
reading 不是 didn't 后所需的动词原形。
will 后接动词原形 return。
will 后不加第三人称单数词尾。
will 后不用过去式 returned。
You must [[1]] your name before borrowing a game.
must 是情态动词，后接动词原形 write。
情态动词后不加第三人称单数词尾。
writing 不是 must 后所需的原形。
I wanted to play outside, [[1]] it was raining heavily.
想外出与大雨形成转折，用 but。
大雨不是想外出玩的原因，because 逻辑不符。
or 表选择，这里不是在两个选项中作选择。
Did 后接动词原形 take。
took 是过去式，不能直接放在 Did 后。
taken 是过去分词，也不是这里所需的原形。
smell 在这里是系动词，用形容词 good 描述橙子的气味。
smell 在这里描述橙子的气味，用形容词，而不是修饰动作的副词 well。
goodness 是名词，不能替代此处的形容词表语。
I saw Amy and gave [[1]] the card.
give 后这里需要指代 Amy 的宾格 her。
she 是主格，不能在这里作 gave 的宾语。
hers 表她的东西，不是这里表示接卡片的人。

cloze.text: Last Saturday, Dan and I made a kite. We wanted to take it to the park, but one corner was still 〔1〕_____. A piece of paper was missing. I wanted to leave it and go out quickly. Dan pointed to our drawing and said, 'That corner needs paper too.' We found an old paper bag and used part of it. The new corner was a different 〔2〕_____, but the kite was complete. At the park, the wind was light. The kite did not fly very 〔3〕_____. We waited instead of pulling harder and harder. Later, a stronger wind lifted it. We 〔4〕_____ the kite before we left, and I was glad we did. A small repair made our afternoon 〔5〕_____.
items: unfinished
perfect
wet
A piece of paper was missing.
缺一块纸说明那个角还没完成。
perfect 表完美，与缺纸矛盾。
原文说缺纸，没有被水弄湿的线索。
colour
price
voice
We found an old paper bag and used part of it.
换用旧纸袋的纸后，新角可能颜色不同。
文章没有买卖或价格比较。
纸角没有这里所说的声音差别。
high
expensive
empty
the wind was light.
风弱时风筝没有飞得很高，fly high 是合理搭配。
expensive 是昂贵的，不能表示飞行高度。
empty 表空的，不修饰这里的飞行状态。
finished
lost
sold
but the kite was complete.
complete 对应离开前完成了风筝。
lost 与风筝完整且带到公园的事实矛盾。
sold 与两人仍在公园放这只风筝矛盾。
better
earlier
impossible
Later, a stronger wind lifted it.
修补后最终能放飞风筝，使下午的活动更好。
earlier 表更早，原文没有说修补让下午提前开始。
impossible 与最终成功放飞相反。

reading.text:
FOUND BAG
A small grey bag was found beside the school gate on Tuesday afternoon. Inside it were a green water bottle, a maths notebook and a bus card with no name. There was no phone. If you think the bag is yours, visit the school office between 3:00 and 4:30 on Wednesday. Describe the picture on the bottle so we can check. Do not bring another person's bus card as proof. The office will keep the bag until the end of the week. If you cannot come at that time, ask your class teacher for help.
items: Where was the bag found?
Beside the school gate.
In a bus.
Inside the school office.
beside the school gate on Tuesday afternoon.
拾到位置是校门旁；办公室是领取地点。
有公交卡不等于在公交车里拾到。
办公室负责保管和领取，不是原文的拾到地点。
What was NOT in the bag?
A phone.
A water bottle.
A maths notebook.
There was no phone.
原文直接排除手机。
绿色水瓶是列出的物品。
数学笔记本也是列出的物品。
How should someone help prove the bag is theirs?
Describe the picture on the bottle.
Bring someone else's bus card.
Say the office is open every night.
Describe the picture on the bottle so we can check.
需要描述瓶子上的图案作核对。
原文明示不能拿别人的公交卡证明。
办公室夜间开放的说法没有依据，也不是证明方式。
What can a student do if they cannot visit at the stated time?
Ask their class teacher for help.
Wait for the office to call them.
Use another student’s bus card as proof.
ask your class teacher for help.
不能按时到场时可向班主任求助。
原文没有办公室打电话通知的安排，不能把它当作给出的解决办法。
原文明确不能使用他人的公交卡作证明。

reading.text: Jia wanted to give her friend Mei a book. Jia loved long adventure stories, so she first chose one with a ship on its cover. Then she remembered their last visit to the library. Mei had spent a long time looking at pictures of plants and asking how seeds grow. Jia put the adventure book back and chose a short book about a school garden. She also wrote a note: 'Tell me which plant you would like to grow.' Mei read the note and smiled. The next week, she showed Jia a drawing of her own little garden plan.
items: Which book did Jia choose first?
An adventure story.
A garden book.
A book about bus routes.
she first chose one with a ship on its cover.
结合前句 long adventure stories，最初选的是冒险故事。
园艺书是她后来更换的选择。
文中没有公交路线书。
What helped Jia change her choice?
Remembering Mei's interest at the library.
Finding that all adventure books were sold out.
Being told that short books cost nothing.
Mei had spent a long time looking at pictures of plants
她回想起 Mei 对植物的兴趣，因而换书。
没有售罄的信息，原情境也是选书而非售罄通知。
没有短书免费或价格比较的内容。
What does the garden plan suggest?
Mei was interested in the book's subject.
Mei refused to read any part of the book.
Jia had to draw every plant for Mei.
she showed Jia a drawing of her own little garden plan.
读后设计自己的花园，与对园艺主题有兴趣相符。
后续行动不支持完全拒绝阅读的说法。
her own 表示 Mei 自己的计划，没有 Jia 代画的要求。
What is the main lesson of the story?
Consider the receiver's interests when choosing a gift.
Always give everyone your favourite kind of book.
A book's cover is the only thing that matters.
Then she remembered their last visit to the library.
选择转折来自记起收礼者的兴趣，而非坚持自己的喜好。
主人公恰恰没有坚持送自己最爱的类型。
她根据 Mei 的兴趣换书，不是只看封面。

task.text:
SATURDAY READING HELP
Our little library needs helpers this Saturday. Arrive at 9:20 for a short introduction. The library opens to visitors at 9:30. Put returned books on the desk, not straight onto the shelves. A librarian will check them first. Keep the path to the door clear. The helper session finishes at eleven. Bring your own water.
items: Helpers should arrive at _____. 用24小时制数字填写，如08:10。
Arrive at 9:20 for a short introduction.
9:20是志愿者到场时间，9:30才向读者开放。
Returned books go on the _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
desk
Put returned books on the desk, not straight onto the shelves.
归还的书先放桌上，不能直接上架。
Keep the path to the door _____. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
clear
Keep the path to the door clear.
clear 在这里说明通道要畅通，不是书架要空。

writing.stem: 写一封约65—85词的英文邮件给朋友，说明班级原计划周六去公园画画，因预计大雨改为在学校美术教室活动。写清周六14:00集合、带纸和铅笔、仍可以画窗外的景物，并请朋友回复。名字可虚构。
writing.model:
Hi Ben,
Our class planned to draw in the park this Saturday, but heavy rain is expected. We will meet in the school art room at two in the afternoon instead. Please bring some paper and a pencil. We can still draw the trees and buildings outside the window, so we do not need to cancel the activity. Let me know if you can come.
Best wishes,
Jia
points: 因预计大雨，由公园改到学校美术教室
writing.organisation: 先解释变化及原因，再给新安排，最后提出回复请求。
writing.language: 区分原计划与新安排的时态；检查地点介词和 will 后的原形。
writing.pitfall: 不要只写下雨而漏掉新地点，也不要把活动说成已经取消。
